open_conflicts_and_disputes.detail: The registry's canonical, currently-standing ARR figure is $330M (as of 2026-08-11). A dense cluster of ~10 unverified articles dated late April through early May 2026 (pulse2.com, TechCrunch, CNBC interview, MSN, theaiinsider.tech, cxodigitalpulse.com, newsbytesapp.com, and Google News harvester rows) all report ElevenLabs 'surpassing $500M ARR' around the same week as the BlackRock/NVIDIA/Jamie Foxx investor news. A third figure ($450M, attributed directly to CEO Staniszewski in the TechCrunch piece) also appears in the same week. None of these three figures has a Verified=YES tag. Not resolved in source data.

Source system's own canon_company_dossiers note states this explicitly: "Signal feed carries a $22B tender-offer report vs $11B registry — unreconciled." The $22B figure traces to July 2026 Bloomberg/TechStartups reporting of early-stage secondary-sale talks (not a closed round) — per house methodology, this is a forward signal, not a base-case valuation.

open_conflicts_and_disputes.topic: Likely date-extraction error on a second $22B mention
open_conflicts_and_disputes.detail: One funding-category record carries the description "ElevenLabs is planning a share sale in September at a USD 22 billion valuation" but is dated 2024-09-01 — two years before the $22B narrative first appears anywhere else in the data (July 2026). No 'Year' field is populated on this record (most other records have one). Far more plausible this refers to September 2026 and the year was mis-parsed; presented as-is without silently correcting the date.

The daily snapshot tracker shows Valuation jumping to $13B and Capital Raised to $850M on 2026-07-30 only, then Valuation reverting to $11B on 2026-07-31 (Capital Raised stayed at $850M). No narrative event corroborates a $13B mark on that date. Flagged as a probable data-ingestion glitch, not a confirmed valuation event.

Two low-authority outlets (techbriefly.com, dataconomy.com) label the ~$500M/$11B Feb-2026 round 'Series C' — the same label already used for the actual Jan-2025 $250M/$3.3B round. Overwhelming majority of sources call the 2026 round 'Series D'; the registry's Latest Valuation/ARR context is consistent with Series D. Treated as mislabeling by those two outlets.
See financials.headcount_conflict above. Canonical Aug-2026 figure (300) sits below Revelio Labs/Latka estimates (580–753) dated Dec 2025–May 2026, i.e., earlier. Not resolved in source data.

curated.Description: ElevenLabs launched in 2022 with a mission to make AI-generated speech indistinguishable from human speech. The company focused on developing text-to-speech technology that produces voices sounding genuinely human in most contexts.
curated.Event Title: ElevenLabs Founded

curated.Description: $2M pre-seed from Credo Ventures and Concept Ventures. ElevenLabs goes viral with voice cloning demo. Social media buzz drives early user acquisition. Best-in-class voice quality immediately recognized.
curated.Event Title: ElevenLabs raises $2M pre-seed — viral voice cloning demo

curated.Description: ElevenLabs launches public beta. Voice cloning, text-to-speech, and AI dubbing. Goes viral — 7M+ users in first months. Best voice quality of any AI system. Creates new content creator use case.
curated.Event Title: ElevenLabs launches public beta — AI voice synthesis platform

curated.Description: $19M seed led by a16z at ~$99M post-money. Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger (Instagram co-founders) invest. 7M+ users. 1M+ voice creations per day. Fastest growing AI consumer product.
curated.Event Title: ElevenLabs raises $19M seed — a16z / Instagram co-founders

curated.Description: ElevenLabs launches commercial API for enterprise voice synthesis. Publishers, audiobook platforms, and game developers as early customers. Real-time voice generation at scale.
curated.Event Title: ElevenLabs API launched — enterprise voice synthesis

curated.Description: $80M Series B led by a16z and Sequoia at $1.1B post-money (unicorn). Enterprise voice AI adoption accelerating. Audiobook, podcast, and media customers growing rapidly. ARR: ~$20M.
curated.Event Title: ElevenLabs raises $80M Series B — a16z / Sequoia — $1.1B valuation

curated.Description: ElevenLabs launches AI dubbing studio, automatically translating and dubbing video content in 29 languages while preserving speaker's voice. Media and entertainment companies as target customers.
curated.Event Title: ElevenLabs launches dubbing studio — video localization

curated.Description: Senator Maggie Hassan, ranking member of the Joint Economic Committee, sent formal requests to ElevenLabs and three other AI voice companies asking how they prevent scammers from using their tools for impersonation fraud. The inquiry follows FBI reports of $893 million in AI voice-related scams.
curated.Event Title: Senator Hassan Demands Answers From ElevenLabs After FBI Reports $893 Million In AI Voice Scams

curated.Description: ElevenLabs crosses $100M ARR. 1M+ developers using the API. 5B+ characters synthesized monthly. Enterprise customers include major publishers, media companies, and game studios.

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs, previously known for clear audio generation through AI, has launched a new product called ElevenMusic. This expansion broadens their offerings beyond text-to-speech into AI-powered music and song generation.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs Introduces ElevenMusic for AI-Powered Music and Song Generation

full_event_log.Description: A group of journalists and voice actors filed a proposed class action lawsuit in Illinois federal court against ElevenLabs and other major tech companies (Google, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia) accusing them of wrongly using plaintiffs' voices to train their artificial intelligence models without authorization.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs hit with class action lawsuit over unauthorized voice use for AI training

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs licensed 200K human-voiced audiobooks from major publishers available in ElevenReader for $11/mo. The company also powered Spotify's new audiobook self-publishing tool as part of Spotify's Audiobook+ initiative.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs licenses 200K human-voiced audiobooks and powers Spotify's audiobook self-publishing tool

full_event_log.Description: Spotify launched an ElevenLabs-powered AI tool enabling authors to create and self-publish audiobooks through its Spotify for Authors platform. The tool was introduced alongside new AI-generated podcast features. This marks a notable integration of ElevenLabs' voice AI technology into Spotify's creator ecosystem.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs powers Spotify's new AI audiobook creation tool for self-publishing authors

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs released SDK v2.49.0 with regenerated API schema for May 18-25, 2026, including ElevenAgents text behavior overrides, music generation_mode, and workspace studio_projects. The update fixed iOS Safari issues with WebSocket voice sessions dropping first agent messages.
full_event_log.Event Title: SDK v2.49.0 Release with ElevenAgents and Music Generation Updates

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs released Music v2, a new music generation model featuring better vocals, instrumentation, and arrangement across every genre. The update also includes improved multilingual support and a set of new capabilities.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs launches Music v2 with improved vocals, instrumentation, and multilingual support

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs announced a partnership with Stan Lee Universe to license Stan Lee's voice and likeness for commercial AI use through the company's Iconic Marketplace. The partnership represents the intersection of corporate immortality and pop-cultural mythology through AI technology.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs licenses Stan Lee's voice and likeness for commercial AI use

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs released a new music-generation model capable of switching genres mid-track. The model also allows users to regenerate specific sections of a song without affecting the rest of the track.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs launches music-generation model with mid-track genre switching

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs transitions from selling a single miracle feature to assembling a comprehensive business stack around speech, audio creation, and conversational systems.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs expands from single feature to integrated business stack

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs expanded its partnership with the UK Government and AISI to improve accessibility of public services using AI. The agreement deepens existing collaboration on research into AI-generated voice perception, citizen identification of AI systems, and impacts on behavior, trust and decision-making.
full_event_log.Event Title: UK Government signs AI partnership with ElevenLabs for public service accessibility

full_event_log.Description: Bloomberg Tech: Europe featured ElevenLabs co-founder in a segment on London's AI boom, describing the company as the UK's most valuable AI start-up. The episode highlighted Britain's leadership in the European AI wave and London's emergence as a global AI hub.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs recognised as UK's most valuable AI start-up

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs' voice technology was used to reconstruct Albert Einstein's voice, enabling future generations of students to learn from a simulated version of the physicist. The article discusses implications for the knowledge economy and access to expertise.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs Platform Used to Rebuild Albert Einstein's Voice

full_event_log.Description: Poland has acquired a stake in AI voice company ElevenLabs with an $11 million investment. The move is part of Poland's broader ambition to establish itself as a major European AI hub.
full_event_log.Event Title: Poland Invests $11 Million in ElevenLabs to Build AI Tech Hub

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs has held early discussions with investors to facilitate a secondary offering that would allow employees to sell shares. The tender offer would value the AI startup at approximately $22 billion.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs in Early Talks for Tender Offer at $22 Billion Valuation

full_event_log.Description: AI voice startup ElevenLabs is exploring a secondary share sale that could value the company at approximately $22 billion. This valuation represents a significant increase from the company's previous $11 billion valuation achieved just six months prior when it raised $500 million.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs explores secondary share sale at $22B valuation

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs officially launched its Canada business on July 7, 2026, appointing Max Lemmens as general manager. The company announced plans to open a Toronto office and double its Canadian team headcount throughout the year.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs launches Canada business and opens Toronto office

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs offers 6 paid pricing tiers ranging from $6 to $990 per month, plus a free tier with 10,000 monthly credits. The pricing structure includes Starter ($6/mo), Creator ($22/mo), Pro ($99/mo), Scale ($299/mo), Business ($990/mo), and custom Enterprise plans.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs Pricing Structure Update

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs posted a job opening for an Indirect Tax Lead position, indicating that indirect compliance has become a standalone function at the company. This signals organizational maturity as the vendor serves thousands of businesses and recognizes the need for dedicated tax expertise.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs establishes indirect tax compliance as standalone function

full_event_log.Description: Enterprise technology partner DXC Technology announced a strategic partnership with voice AI firm ElevenLabs. DXC Technology participated in ElevenLabs' Series D funding round valuing the company at approximately $11 billion.
full_event_log.Event Title: DXC Technology announces strategic partnership with ElevenLabs

full_event_log.Description: DXC Technology announced a strategic partnership with ElevenLabs to accelerate AI-first transformation. The collaboration will embed advanced voice AI capabilities across DXC's internal operations and customer solutions.
full_event_log.Event Title: DXC and ElevenLabs announce strategic partnership for enterprise AI and voice innovation

full_event_log.Description: DXC Technology, a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner, announced a strategic partnership with ElevenLabs, the AI company specializing in audio models and voice agents. The partnership aims to scale enterprise AI and voice innovation.
full_event_log.Event Title: DXC Technology and ElevenLabs announce strategic partnership

full_event_log.Description: ElevenReader app updated on Google Play Store. The app enables users to read aloud eBooks, audiobooks, PDFs or any text using text-to-speech technology.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenReader app updated

full_event_log.Description: DXC Technology announced a new strategic partnership with ElevenLabs to integrate ElevenLabs' voice capabilities into DXC's offerings. The partnership will focus on delivering AI voice agents and copilots for enterprise productivity and customer experience transformation across global clients.
full_event_log.Event Title: DXC Technology forms strategic partnership with ElevenLabs

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs released the Dubbing API, providing developers programmatic access to Dubbing v2, the company's speech-to-speech AI model that preserves emotional tone across 90+ languages. This API launch comes 70 days after the May 2026 UI-only launch of Dubbing v2.
full_event_log.Event Title: ElevenLabs Opens Dubbing API for Programmatic Access

full_event_log.Description: ElevenLabs partners with IDC and Google Cloud to host an executive dinner exploring autonomous customer operations, high-trust workflow governance, and secure-by-design automation foundations. The event focuses on enterprise AI and conversational AI applications in production environments.
full_event_log.Event Title: IDC Executive Dinner in partnership with Google Cloud & ElevenLabs
